digest.component_or_area: Plan review: Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier prompt caching and rendering
propositions: Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier system prompts must share a byte-identical leading prefix containing the plan to enable Anthropic's prompt cache breakpoint at the system-block level across passes

The exhaustiveness directive ('enumerate EVERY independent defect in THIS run') must be injected into the shared preamble and reach all Pass-1 entry points (finder, container, ISF) and the verifier prefix by construction
The finder warm gate currently measures plan tokens alone but must measure shared_plan_prefix tokens to match the bytes actually cached; the threshold remains CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS (4096)

The verifier templates must move the plan from user message into system prompt via a {{shared_prefix}} variable at the template head, remove the volatile marker, and keep per-chunk finding listings (base_instructions) user-turn only

Single-source enforcement: SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE and shared_plan_prefix() must live in prompts.py only; passes._SHARED_PREAMBLE must be deleted to prevent drift; every template and renderer must be audited to supply or receive shared_prefix instead of plan

The plan_review_verify_inputs step output must emit shared_prefix (not plan) and the output schema must drop stale {{plan}} references; both plan-review.yaml verify with: blocks must wire shared_prefix from verify_inputs.outputs
